query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules) as total_molecules,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plants) as total_plants,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plant_molecules) as total_plant_molecules,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule_plant_sources) as total_molecule_plant_sources,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ifra_restrictions) as total_ifra_restrictions,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM plant_molecules) as molecules_with_plants_pm,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM molecule_plant_sources) as molecules_with_plants_mps,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM ifra_restrictions) as molecules_with_ifra;
